ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55:45 ratio of low-intensity black to high-intensity white pixels. Low-intensity pixels dominate the central-inferior region and peduncle interface, while high-intensity pixels are localized to the lateral superior surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark mass bifurcates at the median notch. The left lobe contains a large contiguous white region with minor dark spotting. The right lobe contains a large contiguous white region interrupted by a prominent, dark diagonal linear streak and secondary smaller parallel flecks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 72 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying amplitudes along the continuous linear boundary. The highest amplitude peaks are concentrated at the distal terminal ends, showing rough, granular topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced upward concave curve along the trailing edge leading to elevated, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of irregular, brownish-grey pixel blobs concentrated on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with localized barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark diagonal linear mark on the right white lobe; multiple smaller, faint linear pixel disruptions are visible on the interior white margins of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive terminal clusters of barnacles on distal tips; irregular serration patterns suggesting minor trailing edge wear.
other_distinctive_markers: A primary dark pigmentation streak on the right lobe extending from the black central mass into the white field at a roughly 45-degree angle.
